# ARIF BABU — Media Downloader
Fastest multi-site downloader API wrapper for Node.js.

## Supported Platforms
✔ Instagram
✔ Facebook
✔ TikTok
✔ YouTube
✔ Threads
✔ Twitter
✔ Google Drive
✔ Pinterest
✔ Likee
✔ Capcut
✔ Spotify (Search + Download)
✔ SoundCloud (Search + Download)
✔ Terabox

## Installation
```bash
npm install arifbabu-media-downloader
```

## Usage
```js
const api = require('arifbabu-media-downloader');

(async () => {
  const result = await api.instagram("INSTAGRAM_URL_HERE");
  console.log(result);
})();
```
